body:
Decided: B, like today's food system.
Monkey: fruit mix. Seal: fish. Bear: honey & berries. Snake: snake food. 8 coins each.
Each also eats pet food and treats, like cats and bunnies today (own food first = favourite).
Cost check (Economy): about 1 food a pet a game day; 4 big pets = 32 a day of about 585.

comments.text: Moved to Game rules (Karolis, 31 Oct). Prices follow whatever rule is picked.

Done: B, decided by Game rules (same as today's foods: own food + pet food + treats).
Press Redo to change.

Red team: see 'Pet food: one rule for all pets'.
If you OK it, it replaces this.
Replaced 31 Oct by 'Pet food: 3 food groups' (you OK'd it).

short: New pets: own food (8 coins), also eat pet food and treats
